name: Solar Core — Flame
description:
The molten heart of a thousand missions, too hot to hold for long.

UTILITY (Moon Forge program + oracle):
• +20% XEN burn score for the holder — counts only if held by the same owner at two consecutive epoch snapshots; best Artifact per wallet; it shifts shares within an epoch and never raises the epoch total
• 40 Burn Lottery chips every week (claim_artifact_chips; weeks reset Thursdays 00:00 UTC, missed weeks do not accumulate)
• Ticket to Artifact Duel: any live Artifact lets its holder create or join duels; the element played is chosen freely and hidden by commit-reveal
• Refundable floor: half of the price its buyer paid (30 XNT at the base price) — recycle to get it back. The exact floor of each Artifact is its on-chain "Floor XNT" attribute
• Max 90 alive at any time; recycling frees the slot for a new forge

Base forge price 60 XNT, +5% with every forge and ÷1.05 (-4.76%) per full week without one (never below base, never above 100× base); the buyer signs a max price. Of the price paid: 50% floor, 40% burners' reward pool, 5% Burn Lottery, 5% architect; 5% royalty on secondary sales where honored.
